newsitem.title: USA: Banc One to install cash machines in Sears.
newsitem.headline: Banc One to install cash machines in Sears.

text.p: Banc One Corp will install automated cash dispensing machines in more than 800 Sears, Roebuck and Co's full-line stores in the United States.
The arrangement with Banc One includes the installation of more than 800 Rapid Cash machines in Sears stores by December 1997, the companies said in a joint news release.
Banc One currently has contracts to install about 4,700 Rapid Cash machines during the next twelve months with other retail partners in the United States.
Columbus, Ohio-based Banc One has assets of $101.6 billion and operates 1,502 offices in 12 states.
